adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent`, the organizer attendee email is set from `mainHostDestinationCalendar` (the first element of `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar`) via `email: mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : calEventRaw.organizer.email`, while the actual `calendarId` used for insertion is selected by matching `credentialId` (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`). When creating events for multiple destination calendars, any non-first destination will still get the organizer email taken from the first destination, matching the finding. The same first-element logic is also used in `updateEvent` for organizer email.
